## Sunfire (G4)

Sunfire is a golden-yellow Earth-pony mare with a peach-orange mane and tail, a neckerchief, and a cutie mark of three caramel apples. Look for her among the celebrating ponies after Luna's return in *Friendship is Magic, Part 2*. Her design resembles Apple Bumpkin, Perfect Pie, and Sun Streak, but the [G4 background-mare index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) lists her separately.

**Name and voice:** “Sunfire” is a fan/wiki identification; I found no verified on-screen introduction, official character-name credit, or merchandise naming. In 2020, fan writer Admiral Biscuit noted the alternative Derpibooru label **“Ginger Gold”** in [his story notes](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/887360/story-notes-the-happiest-pony-in-equestria). This is a fan alias, not a secret identity. No individual dialogue or voice actor is verified.

[![Sunfire in the season-one celebration — Friendship is Magic production still](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/59742c403a041155fa409ef0/1505872193666-NI24MF5HEDYHEBNCPLPQ/MLP%2BS1E2%2BSunfire.png)](https://www.macintoshandmaud.com/randopony-of-the-week)

*Still from Hasbro/DHX's* Friendship is Magic, *identified on Macintosh & Maud's episode-by-episode background-pony page.*

## Important moments

- **Celebrating Luna's return** — *Friendship is Magic, Part 2* (S1E2). Sunfire appears in the crowd at the happy conclusion of the Nightmare Moon story; this is a recognizable background appearance, not a speaking or plot-changing action. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SUhksmWw8_8) (scene timestamp not verified).
- **Return to the wider G4 cast** — *My Little Pony: The Movie* (2017; film). The background-pony index also records her in the film, but I could not verify a particular shot or timestamp. [Film information](https://www.fandango.com/my-little-pony-the-movie-201286/movie-overview) (timestamp unavailable).

No character-defining dialogue or decisions are documented; her appearances are cameos rather than personal story arcs.
